title: Auth demo needs 3 things from you (about 5 minutes)

owner_note.text: 1) Google OAuth Client ID (Web type; authorized origins https://staging.lew42.com and https://lew42-app.lew42.workers.dev) and your Google email, so real sign-in works. 2) Enable R2 in the Cloudflare dashboard (error 10042) so document snapshots can be saved. Live editing already works on staging without R2: median 46 ms to reach the other phone, 115 ms from keystroke to visible. Phone test URL today (dev sign-in is off there, so only seeded fake users exist): https://staging.lew42.com
